description:
Simple pub/sub channel for extensions to communicate with each other.
Exposed via ExtensionAPI as api.events.

**API:**
- emit(channel :: String.t(), data :: term()) :: :ok
- on(channel :: String.t(), handler :: (term() -> :ok)) :: unsubscribe_fn
- clear() :: :ok

**Implementation:** GenServer or Registry-based. Handlers execute
asynchronously (fire-and-forget). Errors in handlers logged, don't
propagate.

**Usage pattern (from upstream examples/extensions/event-bus.ts):**
```
# Extension A:
api.events.on("my:notification", fn data -> notify(data) end)

# Extension B:
api.events.emit("my:notification", %{message: "hello", from: "ext-b"})
```

**Upstream ref:** event-bus.ts (34 lines)
title: EventBus: inter-extension pub/sub
